text: It too divides tangentially. Outwards it cuts off cork, the phellem. Its walls are soaked with suberin, the cells die, and the layer becomes waterproof and gas proof. Inwards it cuts off phelloderm, a thin layer of living cells sometimes called secondary cortex.
